card.text: HD 59088 is the central star of the planetary nebula NGC 2392, about 1,795 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110
sources.locator: Table A.1, PN G197.8+17.3: the nebula's central star in Gaia EDR3, distance 1,795 pc (1,666 to 1,942)

introduction.text: Spectra give it about 40,000 K and 1.5 solar radii. It circles an unseen companion, probably a hot white dwarf, every 1.9 days.

sources.label: Kaschinski, Pauldrach & Hoffmann (2012), A&A 542, A45
sources.locator: Table 2, NGC 2392, the model of Pauldrach et al. (2004): Teff 40 000 K, R 1.5 solar radii, log g 3.7

sources.label: Miszalski et al. (2019), arXiv:1903.07264
sources.locator: Abstract and Table 2: a single-lined spectroscopic binary with an orbital period of 1.902208 d; the companion is probably a hot white dwarf

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
